mock_design.diff_classes: off-diagonal joint classes (peak bin != integrated bin): resolved/migrating components
mock_design.flux_scatter: provider 1-sigma; shared deviate if integrated==peak, else independent; integrated>=peak enforced
mock_design.totals: each class total fixed by the perturbed footprint catalogue; pixel placement multinomial

scope: Null mocks are Cox processes with positions independent of the flux pair; the common dipole cancels in the contrast by construction. Clustering amplitudes are fitted to the data's own NSIDE=4 delete-one jackknife traces (one sky); the angular shape of each field is assumed, not fitted. The mocks do not model source multiplicity explicitly, spatially varying flux calibration, or a physical redshift-dependent bias. p_mc are conditional on each family's assumptions; no physical Pi or Bianchi inference is made.
